every_other_rule_holds: The range 0 + 2^46 ≤ stored_block_count 2^46 holds, and the counts and size are positive. Image level would need an Object row with stored_block_count ≥ 2^46. Its structural row can be written (see overflow-7.2-T/isolated for such a prefix), but the image would then carry the same caveat about an unmeasured prefix (NOTES.md gap 10), so the unit form is the clean one.
